title: Cube Conundrum
description: Check game feasibility with limited cubes and find minimum required sets.
writeup:
## Approach

Each game consists of several rounds where the elf reveals a handful of colored cubes. Parse the color counts per round.

## Part 1

A game is possible if no single reveal exceeds the bag's limits (12 red, 13 green, 14 blue). Sum the IDs of all possible games.

## Part 2

For each game, the minimum viable bag needs at least as many cubes of each color as the maximum seen in any round. The "power" of a set is the product of these three minimums. Sum the powers across all games.
